payment_detail_rule: Invoice numbers, amounts, batches, and payment dates may be sent only to a currently verified individual vendor finance contact.
alias_rule: A distribution alias requires a current membership attestation before receiving payment details.
fallback: If a current individual is verified, send directly to that one address; otherwise pause and request vendor-contact validation.
evidence_limit: Mailbox sender, display label, CC, and prior message history do not verify current alias membership.
